claim_text_patches.text: Encounter item whose "you" addressee is not resolved by the packet: terminology could refer to the respondent or the interviewer, so the report grain cannot be fixed; only if administration is interviewer-delivered would it describe representatives approaching the interviewer during field contact rather than the respondent's own political contact, and no such design assumption is made here.

Both owner questions offer the executive as a possible owner of oversight for MPs and the parliament/council as an offered option; naming the executive for the legislature is structurally available, but the separate office targets do not by themselves license a claim about a person-level reasoning frame unless same-respondent administration and linkage of Q48A and Q48B are verified, which this packet does not establish.

inquiry_patches.question: Prerequisite: all three items (Q50B, Q51A, Q51B) must be verified as administered to the same respondents with linkage established before any cross-item comparison; given that, does anticipated harassment of a woman candidate co-occur with a different women's-rights priority and a different demand direction than a general-expansion stance, i.e., are hostile-environment perceivers more likely to name gender-based violence and demand more government action than those who expect little sanction?
inquiry_patches.alternatives: If high anticipated sanction pairs with gender-based-violence priority and more-government demand, this supports a threat-to-priority linkage; if high-sanction respondents name structural issues (pay, property) or prefer the status quo, the sanction-expectation and policy-preference accounts are rival readings; without verified same-respondent administration and linkage of all three items, no pairing is interpreted.
inquiry_patches.ceiling: Cross-sectional metadata only; all three item administration and same-respondent linkage are a prerequisite, not established by this packet; priority is capped-choice so nonselection does not imply low importance, and nothing establishes that expectations cause demand.
